description: Send a problem report to the Professor Otter team, who store it to fix the problem. Call this only after the person agrees: when a Professor Otter tool fails, returns something wrong, or a puzzle, maker or option the person needs is missing, offer to report it, show them the report you would send, and wait for a yes. Report only about this server's tools, never about the host app or other tools. Leave out names, ages, schools and any other personal details: write "a child's name", not the name. Never include secrets. Send one report per problem.

expected.description: What you expected the tool to do.

message.description: What went wrong or what is missing, with no personal details.

source.description: model when you noticed the problem and the person agreed to report it, user when the person asked you to report it.

tool.description: The Professor Otter tool the report is about.

type.description: bug: a tool failed or gave a wrong result. missing: a needed puzzle, maker or option. idea: anything else.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to Professor Otter
